def get_motion_data(scope_title):
    scope = node_by_title(doc, scope_title)
    children = scope_nodes(doc, scope)
    motion_data = []
    for node in children:
        if node.get("kind") == "table" and "Motion log" in node["title"]:
            for row in node["table"]["rows"]:
                frame = int(row[0])
                obj_id = row[1].split(" ")[0]
                x, y = float(row[2]), float(row[3])
                vx, vy = float(row[4]), float(row[5])
                speed = float(row[6])
                motion_data.append({"frame": frame, "obj_id": obj_id, "x": x, "y": y, "vx": vx, "vy": vy, "speed": speed})
            break
    return motion_data
